description: This file is a shell script used for testing integration between git and svn using the git-svn tool. It includes setup for a test environment, initiates SVN repositories, creates files, commits changes, and performs svn dcommit operations to push changes over svn.

methods.name: require_svnserve
methods.description: Ensures that svnserve (the SVN server) is available for testing.

methods.name: start_svnserve
methods.description: Starts the SVN server for testing purposes.
